title: Practice 1: Максим Горький · Нунча («Сказки об Италии», XXII)

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Наконец, мужчина — не бог, а только ___ (бог) нельзя изменить…
exercises.why: «The person who needs something (or someone) is in the dative case … The logical subject, when used with можно or нельзя, is in the dative case.» «This verb (нравиться) is used with the agent in the Dative case and the object (of the liking) in the Nominative case.» — DLI, Lessons 35, 36, 66. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «The person who needs something (or someone) is in the dative case … The logical subject, when used with можно or нельзя, is in the dative case.» «This verb (нравиться) is used with the agent in the Dative case and the object (of the liking) in the Nominative…

exercises.q: Проходит год, два, — дочь всё ближе к ___ (мать) и — дальше от нее.
exercises.why: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29.

exercises.q: Кто разлюбил ___ (женщина) — значит, он не умеет любить…
exercises.why: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions кого? — whom? or что? — what?» — DLI, Lesson 18.

exercises.q: Он, разумеется, хохотал, спрятав умные глазки в ___ (красный жир) своих щек.
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Он, разумеется, хохотал, спрятав умные глазки в ___ (красный) жир своих щек.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Вы только посмотрите сквозь ___ (ваш стакан) на солнце, — вино расскажет вам такие сказки…
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Хорошо, ты не станешь жаловаться мадонне на ___ (твоя мать)…
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.why: Максим Горький · Нунча («Сказки об Италии», XXII) — Максим Горький, «Нунча («Сказки об Италии», XXII)» (public domain). Explanations: the DLI Grammar Reference Book.  ·  «b. The nominative of the predicate: Мой брат — студент.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: Максим Горький · Нунча («Сказки об Италии», XXII) (Максим Горький, «Нунча («Сказки об Италии», XXII)» (public domain). Explanations: the DLI Grammar Reference Book)

exercises.q: ___ (доктор) сказал, что она умерла от разрыва сердца.
exercises.why: «The main functions of the nominative case are: a. The nominative of the subject: Студент читает.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «The main functions of the nominative case are: a. The nominative of the subject: Студент читает.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Кто ___ (разлюбить) женщину — значит, он не умеет любить…
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: Кто разлюбил женщину — значит, он не ___ (уметь) любить…
exercises.why: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense. The letter в is inserted in all present tense forms of the verb жить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense.

exercises.q: Не ___ (успеть) допить свой стакан до половины, а к нему уже потянулась новая рука…
exercises.why: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37.

exercises.q: Ты, ___ (казать / казаться), думаешь, что любовь — наука такая же трудная, как богословие?
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: На ___ (какой) языке будет говорить со мною этот сто раз выстиранный синьор?
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: ___ (молодой), а волосы уже седые, и поперек лица — шрам; лицо — разбойника, глаза святого.
exercises.why: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  «Больной, раненый and знакомый are often used as adjectival nouns.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative.

exercises.q: Даже ___ (сам) Нунча удивилась, присмотревшись к ней:
exercises.why: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative.

exercises.q: На ___ (язык) золотых монет, дурочка, — убеждали ее солидные люди, но она отвечала:
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Максим Горький, «Нунча».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.
